payload.text: **hv, 28 Oct: one project at a time, done today.** hv at 05:50Z: "Ok, let's do this, but I want to go one project at a time." and "I am _very_ much expecting to get this done and dusted asap." The desk serves one project until it is READY TO CUT, and then the next: Utilz, devbin, Molt, Gtools, Intent, Laksa, Conflab (vc's order within decision 22's layers, Utilz first as the nearest to its end-point). This replaces decision 23's lights from any project beside the heavy: today only the current project's runs go, side by side as lanes allow. At 06:55Z hv held every Claude ("Jobs that are running (tests, etc) can keep running, but do not start anything new"), and at 07:02Z called an estate localfold+compact, then hold. The hold stands until hv lifts it.
